usageTipContent: Quy tắc được tạo có thể được sử dụng trực tiếp cho việc lọc quảng cáo router, hỗ trợ firmware Asus, Merlin, OpenWrt và các firmware khác

Block ads and trackers at the DNS layer: DNS Shield turns domain lists into router-ready rules.
Ad-free home network? DNS Shield generates hosts/dnsmasq/AdGuard rules — set up once, protect everywhere.
heroTitle: Block ads and trackers at your network's entry
heroDesc: Paste domains or bulk import, generate 9 format rules in one click, deploy straight to your router or DNS service.
